articles.title: Japan PPI stays elevated at 7.2%, misses forecast, but yen keeps BOJ hike case alive
articles.expand: The miss against forecast should not be read as genuine disinflation. At 7.2%, Japanese producer price growth remains near multi-year highs, and the shortfall against the 7.4% consensus is a modest undershoot on an already elevated base rather than a meaningful turn in the trend. The more important number here is the 29.1% jump in yen-based import prices, a scale of imported cost pressure that keeps the structural case for a September BOJ hike firmly intact regardless of the headline miss.
